constants.definition: exact SI elementary charge, not an experimental measurement

limitations.nominal_conductance_pS: Uses the reported dominant step amplitude and nominal common-condition reversal mean from different bilayers, not a per-event paired conductance or a new independent observation. Source also reports roughly7pS.
limitations.monovalent_charge_equivalent_rate_per_s: Current/e gives charge-equivalent count. F-specific ion assignment is conditional on the selectivity interpretation; no numerical F-current fraction is measured here.
limitations.open_main_state_contribution_threshold_p: Reported >95% main-open occupancy gives a > threshold for the full-open-state contribution only under common-condition/current-level assumptions; not measured total time-average flux or confidence.
limitations.matched_liposome_limit_quotient: Native reported-limit arithmetic on >30000 and <30 gives >1000 only conditionally on the authors unit/limit interpretation; Results additionally qualifies the F lower estimate approximately. It does not independently reproduce the authors stronger combined >1e4 claim.
limitations.concentration_vs_reported_activity_ratio: A nominal concentration ratio is not an activity ratio; no Nernst or GHK recalculation without needed temperature/activity assumptions.
